title: FederationClient::new() allocates a new reqwest::Client per use
description: src/federation.rs:84-98, used in inbox.rs:472-473 and interactions.rs:918-919. FederationClient::new() builds a new reqwest::Client (with TLS context, connection pool, etc.) on every actor fetch. reqwest::Client is designed to be shared — creating one per request wastes the internal connection pool and forces fresh TLS handshakes. The delivery worker correctly reuses a single client (delivery.rs:97-103). FederationClient should be stored in AppState or use a LazyLock static like CARD_CLIENT and PUSH_CLIENT already do.
